KKA0290-PCOP100.lead: A small clear pot for olive oil or chocolate sauce at the finishing station.
p: The Kitchenary Kart PC Liquid Chocolate Holder/Olive Oil Pot Topping Ingredient Container in the 100ml size is a see-through polycarbonate pot with a narrow spout, a loop handle and a round ball-shaped lid that lifts off. It stands about 10cm tall and 7cm across, so it fits between plates on a dessert or garnish counter.

Keep one finishing liquid in it at a time: olive oil for drizzling over pasta or bruschetta, chocolate sauce for waffles and sundaes, or syrup for pancakes. The clear body shows the level, so staff can top up before a rush.
b: Size: 100ml capacity, roughly 10cm high and 7cm wide as marked on the product photo.
Material: Polycarbonate (PC) looks clear like glass but is lighter and far less likely to shatter if knocked over.
Pointed spout: A slim tip lets you run a thin line of oil or sauce exactly where it is wanted.
Lid and handle: The round lid keeps dust out between uses, and the loop handle gives a steady grip while pouring.
KKA0290-PCOP100.suit: Dessert counters, cafés, pizzerias and garnish stations that finish plates with olive oil, chocolate or syrup.
KKA0290-PCOP100.care: Wash in warm soapy water with a soft sponge and rinse well; avoid steel wool and strong solvents, which scratch or cloud polycarbonate. Dry the spout and lid before refilling.
KKA0290-PCOP100.title: PC Oil & Chocolate Pouring Pot - 100ml
KKA0290-PCOP100.meta: Kitchenary Kart's clear 100ml polycarbonate pot has a spout, loop handle and lift-off lid for olive oil, chocolate sauce or syrup on dessert counters.

KKA0291-PCOP200.lead: A wider 200ml pourer for sauces and oils used all through service.
p: The Kitchenary Kart PC Liquid Chocolate Holder/Olive Oil Pot Topping Ingredient Container in the 200ml size has a squat, tapered polycarbonate body, a tall angular handle and a short spout. It measures roughly 18cm from end to end, 10cm high and 8cm across the base.

The bigger volume means fewer refills for items poured again and again, such as chocolate or caramel over desserts, olive oil on salads and pizzas, or honey on pancakes. A small lid with a thumb tab sits in the top opening and lifts out for refilling.
b: Size: 200ml capacity; 18cm long overall and 10cm high.
Material: Polycarbonate (PC) looks clear like glass but is lighter and far less likely to shatter if knocked over.
Angled handle: Its high, open shape keeps fingers away from warm sauce and gives control on a slow pour.
Wide base: The 8cm flat bottom sits firmly on a tray or counter, even when the pot is full.
KKA0291-PCOP200.suit: Bakeries, waffle and pancake counters, salad bars and buffet lines that pour sauces, honey or oil through the day.
KKA0291-PCOP200.care: Wash in warm soapy water with a soft sponge and rinse well; avoid steel wool and strong solvents, which scratch or cloud polycarbonate. Dry the spout and lid before refilling.
KKA0291-PCOP200.title: PC Oil & Chocolate Pouring Pot - 200ml
KKA0291-PCOP200.meta: Pour chocolate, caramel, honey or olive oil from this 200ml clear PC pot with angled handle, short spout and tabbed lid, sold by Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0292-SSGSOB4.lead: Oil bottles and seasoning shakers in one black caddy.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Glass Based Salt + Oil Bottle 200ml Set 4PP - Black groups 200ml glass oil bottles and square shakers in a black stand with a steel carry rod. Each bottle is about 20cm tall with a pour spout and flip cap, and each shaker stands 10cm high under a steel-trimmed lid.

Keep it on the pass or a buffet station so oil for dressing and salt or chilli flakes for finishing sit together, then lift the whole caddy by its centre rod to move it. The shaker lids turn to switch between hole sizes, from a fine sprinkle to a coarser shake.
b: Bottles: 200ml each in clear glass, 20cm tall and 5cm wide, fitted with pour spouts and flip caps.
Shakers: Square jars 10cm high and 4.5cm wide, with rotating lids that change the opening.
Stand: Black base with a slot for every piece and a steel rod handle, 24cm tall and 11.5cm wide.
See-through bodies: Staff can check oil and seasoning levels without opening anything.
KKA0292-SSGSOB4.suit: Restaurant pass counters, buffet and salad stations, and dining tables where oil and dry seasoning are used side by side.
KKA0292-SSGSOB4.care: Take off the spouts and lids and wash them apart from the glass; rinse, then let every part dry fully before refilling. Handle the bottles gently, never pour boiling liquid into a cold one, and replace any piece that chips.
KKA0292-SSGSOB4.title: SS & Glass Oil Bottle & Shaker Set - Black
KKA0292-SSGSOB4.meta: Kitchenary Kart black caddy set with 200ml glass oil bottles, pour spouts and square shakers with turning lids, lifted by a steel rod for pass and buffet use.
conflicts: Piece count: listing name says 4PP and the document says 4 pieces, but the components photo shows 2 oil bottles + 2 shakers + a stand and the box in the photos reads '5 pieces' (likely 4 containers + stand). No piece count written in the copy; the listing name quoted in p1 still carries '4PP'.

KKA0293-SOBWBR.lead: Hold the oil and brush it on with one hand.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Silicone Oil Bottle + Brush - Mix Colour is a small oil bottle with a silicone basting brush at its neck. It holds up to 60ml (2.0 oz), has ml and oz marks printed on the side, and a clear cap fits over the bristles between uses.

Oil and brush travel together, so there is no separate bowl to dip into or drip from. The photos show it greasing a foil-lined baking tray, glazing a bun, oiling a pan and basting sausages and chicken wings for the grill.
b: Capacity: Up to 60ml (2.0 oz), with a printed scale to see how much is left.
Silicone head: Soft tips spread a thin, even coat of oil, melted butter or glaze.
Clear cap: A see-through cover keeps the brush head clean in a drawer or tool caddy.
Mix Colour: Brush heads come in assorted shades such as orange, green, blue and red, as seen in the photos.
KKA0293-SOBWBR.suit: Bakeries, grill and tandoor stations, dosa and tawa counters, and cafés that oil trays, pans or bread before cooking.
KKA0293-SOBWBR.care: Wash the brush head and bottle in warm soapy water, working the suds between the bristles, then rinse until no oily film remains. Stand it upside down to air-dry and keep the silicone away from open flame.
KKA0293-SOBWBR.title: Silicone Oil Bottle + Brush - Mix Colour
KKA0293-SOBWBR.meta: Grease trays, pans and grills with this 60ml silicone oil bottle from Kitchenary Kart, fitted with a basting brush, ml/oz scale and clear bristle cap.
conflicts: Pack quantity: the name reads as one bottle, but several photos show 3-4 bottles in different brush colours; whether one piece or an assortment is sold is unclear, so no count is written.

KKA0294-V2.1GOD500WB.lead: Oil in white, vinegar in black, labelled so nobody mixes them up.
p: The VAMA 2 in 1 Glass Oil & Vinegar Dispenser - 500ml | White + Black from Kitchenary Kart is a pair of tall square glass bottles, a white one printed OIL and a black one printed VINEGAR, each holding 500ml. Both stand 30.5cm high on a 5.5cm square base.

A slim metal spout lets a thin, steady stream fall onto a salad or into a pan, and a small black cap on a strap covers the tip when the bottles are not in use. Their narrow footprint leaves room on a crowded prep table or beside the cooking range.
b: Capacity: 500ml in each bottle, so refills come around less often during service.
Labelled pair: Bold printed lettering tells staff which bottle holds oil and which holds vinegar.
Spout and cap: Metal pouring spouts with tethered caps keep dust and insects off the tip.
Size: Each bottle is 30.5cm tall and 5.5cm square at the base.
KKA0294-V2.1GOD500WB.suit: Salad counters, Continental and Italian kitchens, café dining tables and live pasta stations.
KKA0294-V2.1GOD500WB.care: Take out the spouts and wash them separately; swirl warm soapy water through each bottle with a bottle brush, rinse and leave upside down until dry inside. Glass can crack if knocked or if hot liquid goes into a cold bottle, so fill and handle it with care.
KKA0294-V2.1GOD500WB.title: VAMA Oil & Vinegar Set 500ml White/Black
KKA0294-V2.1GOD500WB.meta: VAMA 500ml glass oil and vinegar bottles in white and black, with metal pour spouts and tethered caps for salad and cooking lines, from Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0295-V4.1GOSCWB.lead: Oil, vinegar, salt and pepper in one carry stand.
p: The VAMA 4 in 1 Glass Oil & Spice Canister Set with Metal Stand - White + Black from Kitchenary Kart holds four printed glass containers: OIL and VINEGAR bottles of 170ml each and SALT and PEPPER shakers of 80ml each, in white and black. All four sit in a wire frame with a tall loop handle.

Carry the set from the kitchen to a table or buffet in one trip, or keep it by the stove so dressing and seasoning stay within reach. The bottles pour through slim metal spouts, and the shakers have perforated lids.
b: Four containers: Two 170ml bottles for oil and vinegar and two 80ml shakers for salt and pepper.
Metal stand: Black wire caddy with a raised handle, about 22.5cm tall on a 10.5cm by 11.5cm footprint.
Colour coding: White and black finishes with bold labels makes each piece quick to pick out.
Non-porous glass: The containers do not soak up smells from dressings or spices between refills.
KKA0295-V4.1GOSCWB.suit: Family restaurants and dhabas, hotel room-service trays, buffet lines and café dining tables.
KKA0295-V4.1GOSCWB.care: Wash bottles and shakers by hand in warm soapy water, dry them completely before refilling salt or pepper, and wipe the wire stand with a damp cloth. Grip the handle firmly when carrying a full set, since glass breaks if dropped.
KKA0295-V4.1GOSCWB.title: VAMA 4 in 1 Oil & Spice Set White/Black
KKA0295-V4.1GOSCWB.meta: VAMA 4 in 1 glass set from Kitchenary Kart: 170ml oil and vinegar bottles plus 80ml salt and pepper shakers in a black metal stand with handle.

KKA0296-VGSSOD180B.lead: A short matte-black dispenser that lives beside the stove.
p: The VAMA Glass + SS Oil/Vinegar Dispenser - 180ml | Black from Kitchenary Kart is a compact 180ml glass bottle in a matte black finish, topped with a stainless-steel collar and angled pouring spout. It stands 18cm tall and 5.3cm wide, small enough to keep one at each cooking station.

A hinged flap on the steel spout closes over the tip, and the angled nozzle gives a controlled pour onto salads or into a kadhai. The size also works for vinegar, sesame oil or chilli oil set out on a table.
b: Capacity: 180ml, sized for a single station or table rather than bulk storage.
Build: Glass body in matte black with a stainless-steel collar and spout.
Flap tip: The hinged cover helps keep dust and flies away from the oil.
Size: 18cm tall and 5.3cm in diameter.
KKA0296-VGSSOD180B.suit: Tawa and wok stations, salad bars, Chinese and Continental kitchens, and café tables that keep oil or vinegar within reach.
KKA0296-VGSSOD180B.care: Unscrew the steel top and wash it and the bottle in warm soapy water; dry the collar with a cloth to avoid water marks. Treat the glass gently, and do not fill it with oil that is still hot.
KKA0296-VGSSOD180B.title: VAMA Glass & SS Oil Dispenser 180ml Black
KKA0296-VGSSOD180B.meta: Kitchenary Kart offers the VAMA 180ml matte black glass oil and vinegar dispenser with steel collar and hinged flap spout for wok and tawa stations.

KKA0297-VGOD500B.lead: A tall black bottle with gold script for everyday olive oil.
p: The VAMA Glass Oil Dispenser - 500ml | Black from Kitchenary Kart is a slim square glass bottle in glossy black with the word Oil written in gold script down its side. It holds 500ml, stands 33.5cm tall on a 5.5cm base and is topped with a gold-tone pouring spout.

The spout carries a small hinged flap at the tip, and the photos show it running a fine stream straight into a stir-fry pan. Dark glass also shades the contents from light when the bottle is kept on an open shelf.
b: Capacity: 500ml in a narrow body that takes up little shelf width.
Finish: Glossy black with gold lettering that looks neat on an open kitchen counter.
Pour spout: Gold-tone spout with a flap tip for a slim, steady flow.
Size: 33.5cm tall with a 5.5cm square base.
KKA0297-VGOD500B.suit: Open kitchens, stir-fry and sauté stations, pizzerias and restaurant tables where the bottle stays on show.
KKA0297-VGOD500B.care: Remove the pourer, clean it and the bottle with warm soapy water and a bottle brush, then drain upside down until fully dry. Avoid pouring hot oil into the glass, and store it where it cannot be knocked off a shelf.
KKA0297-VGOD500B.title: VAMA Glass Oil Dispenser 500ml - Black
KKA0297-VGOD500B.meta: VAMA 500ml black glass oil bottle with gold Oil script and gold-tone flap spout, 33.5cm tall, for open kitchens and sauté lines. Buy it at Kitchenary Kart.
conflicts: Spout material: the document's prose mentions stainless-steel details, but its spec lists glass only and the photos show a gold-tone spout; the spout metal is not named in the copy.

KKA0298-VGOSB.lead: A ribbed bottle with a pump-top mister.
p: The VAMA Glass Oil Spray Bottle - 240ml | Transparent from Kitchenary Kart has a clear, ribbed glass body and a brass-tone pump with a push-down plunger, a curved finger loop and a side nozzle that releases a fine mist. It holds 240ml and measures about 18cm tall and 8.5cm wide.

Pressing the plunger gives a light, spread-out spray instead of a pour, for example a thin film of oil over salad leaves or bread before toasting. The see-through body shows how much is left, and the broad base keeps it steady on a shelf.
b: Capacity: 240ml, with the level visible through the clear body.
Pump sprayer: Brass-tone plunger, finger loop and side nozzle for a fine mist.
Ribbed glass: Vertical ribbing gives the bottle a decorative look on open shelves.
Size: About 18cm tall with an 8.5cm-wide body.
KKA0298-VGOSB.suit: Café counters, salad and sandwich prep, and bakery tables where a light spray is wanted instead of a pour.
KKA0298-VGOSB.care: After use, spray warm water through the pump so nothing dries inside the nozzle, then wash the bottle and let it dry. Handle the glass with care and keep it away from flames and hot hobs.
KKA0298-VGOSB.title: VAMA Glass Oil Spray Bottle 240ml Clear
KKA0298-VGOSB.meta: VAMA 240ml clear ribbed glass spray bottle with a brass-tone pump, finger loop and side nozzle for a fine mist, about 18cm tall, on Kitchenary Kart.
conflicts: WHAT IT IS: the photos show a decorative ribbed-glass pump mister of the plant-mister type, used to mist house plants and as a face mist; no photo shows oil or food use, and the box reads 'Premium Glass Spray Bottle' with no mention of oil. Confirm it is sold as a kitchen oil sprayer before applying; the oil-use line in p2 rests on the listing name only.

KKA0347-V2.1GSPSWSWB.lead: White salt, black pepper, one wire stand.
p: The VAMA 2 in 1 Glass Salt & Pepper Set with Stand - White + Black from Kitchenary Kart pairs a white SALT shaker and a black PEPPER shaker, 80ml each, in a matching wire holder with an arched handle. Both close with screw-on caps punched with a spread of holes.

Set one on each dining table or keep it at the pass for finishing plates, and lift the pair by the handle when clearing up. At about 13cm tall on an 11cm by 5.3cm base, it needs little room beside the napkin holder.
b: Capacity: 80ml in each shaker.
Colour pairing: White glass for salt and black glass for pepper, each printed with its name.
Wire stand: The metal holder keeps both shakers upright and together on the table.
Size: About 13cm tall overall with an 11cm by 5.3cm footprint.
KKA0347-V2.1GSPSWSWB.suit: Restaurant and café tables, dhaba counters, hotel breakfast buffets and room-service trays.
KKA0347-V2.1GSPSWSWB.care: Unscrew the caps and hand-wash the shakers, then let them dry completely before refilling so salt does not clump. Wipe the stand with a damp cloth, and remember the glass breaks if it falls on a hard floor.
KKA0347-V2.1GSPSWSWB.title: VAMA Salt & Pepper Stand Set White/Black
KKA0347-V2.1GSPSWSWB.meta: VAMA white and black glass salt and pepper shakers, 80ml each, with screw caps and a wire carry stand for dining tables, from Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0348-V2.1GSPSWOSB.lead: A plain white pair with bold black lettering.
p: The VAMA 2 in 1 Glass Salt & Pepper Set without Stand - White from Kitchenary Kart is two white square glass shakers marked SALT and PEPPER in black print, each holding 80ml. Silver-tone screw caps with small holes sit on top, and each shaker stands 9.5cm high and 4cm wide.
With no stand to find space for, the pair slips into a tray, cruet box or drawer and fits the tight corners of small café tables. The all-white finish goes well with minimal table settings.
b: Capacity: 80ml per shaker.
Printed labels: Large SALT and PEPPER lettering tells guests which is which.
Caps: Silver-tone perforated caps unscrew for refilling.
Size: 9.5cm tall with a 4cm-wide square body.
KKA0348-V2.1GSPSWOSB.suit: Café and QSR tables, food-court counters, hotel room trays and outdoor catering setups.
KKA0348-V2.1GSPSWOSB.care: Remove the caps, wash the glass in warm soapy water and dry inside and out before filling. Glass chips when knocked against other shakers, so store the pair with a little space between them.
KKA0348-V2.1GSPSWOSB.title: VAMA Salt & Pepper Set No Stand - White
KKA0348-V2.1GSPSWOSB.meta: Kitchenary Kart stocks this VAMA pair of white glass salt and pepper shakers with black lettering and silver-tone caps, 80ml each and 9.5cm tall.

KKA0349-VGBSS.lead: A clear, bulb-shaped shaker that shows off the salt.
p: The VAMA Glass Bulb Shaped Salt Shaker - Transparent from Kitchenary Kart has a rounded body shaped like a light bulb, with a silver-tone screw cap pierced by a few pouring holes. It stands about 11cm tall and 7cm across at its widest point.

Because the body is see-through, staff can tell when the salt is running low without opening it, and the rounded base sits steady on a table. The photos show it seasoning eggs and plates and filling a small bowl, so it works for table salt or any fine, dry seasoning.
b: Bulb shape: A rounded, eye-catching outline that is easy to hold.
Transparent glass: The level stays visible from across the counter.
Cap: Screw-on silver-tone cap with a small number of holes for a measured sprinkle.
Size: About 11cm tall and 7cm wide.
KKA0349-VGBSS.suit: Café and restaurant tables, breakfast buffets, egg stations and snack counters.
KKA0349-VGBSS.care: Wash by hand and dry fully before refilling, since damp glass makes salt cake. Keep it back from counter edges, as the glass can crack if dropped.
KKA0349-VGBSS.title: VAMA Glass Bulb Salt Shaker - Transparent
KKA0349-VGBSS.meta: VAMA bulb-shaped transparent glass salt shaker with silver-tone screw cap, about 11cm tall, for café and restaurant tables. Available from Kitchenary Kart.
conflicts: Quantity: the name and document describe one shaker, but one photo shows two bulb shakers side by side; no quantity written in the copy.

KKA0350-VSGSPSR.lead: Round steel-and-glass shakers with a twist top.
p: The VAMA SS + Glass Salt & Pepper Set in the Round option from Kitchenary Kart is a pair of 110ml shakers with a brushed stainless-steel upper body over a clear glass base. Each is about 11.5cm tall and 5.5cm wide with a gently curved profile.

Twist the top to move between fine holes, a wider opening and a closed setting, so one shaker can handle fine salt, cracked pepper or chilli flakes. The clear window at the bottom shows the fill level at a glance.
b: Capacity: 110ml in each shaker.
Material: Stainless-steel shell with a clear glass lower section.
Adjustable top: The rotating lid offers different hole sizes plus a shut position.
Round size: About 11.5cm tall and 5.5cm across.
KKA0350-VSGSPSR.suit: Restaurant tables, BBQ and grill counters, café condiment stations and home-style dining areas.
KKA0350-VSGSPSR.care: Unscrew the top, wash both parts in warm soapy water and dry thoroughly, as wet steel can spot and damp shakers make salt clump. Handle the glass base carefully and replace a shaker if it chips.
KKA0350-VSGSPSR.title: VAMA SS Glass Salt & Pepper - Round 110ml
KKA0350-VSGSPSR.meta: Round VAMA stainless steel and glass salt and pepper shakers, 110ml each, with twist tops for fine or wide pouring. Order from Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0351-VSGSPSS.lead: Square steel shakers with script labels and a turn-to-set cap.
p: The VAMA SS + Glass Salt & Pepper Set in the Square option from Kitchenary Kart is a pair of 120ml shakers with square stainless-steel sleeves, printed Salt and Pepper in script, set over clear glass bases. Each measures about 11.2cm tall and 4.5cm wide.

A black cap turns to choose between several small holes, two holes or one large opening, handy when moving from table salt to a coarser spice. The flat sides let the pair stand close together or tuck onto a narrow shelf.
b: Capacity: 120ml per shaker.
Material: Stainless-steel shell with a clear glass lower section.
Three-way cap: The rotating black top has three hole patterns to pick from.
Square size: 11.2cm tall with a 4.5cm by 4.5cm base.
KKA0351-VSGSPSS.suit: Café and QSR tables, buffet condiment stations, BBQ counters and hotel dining rooms.
KKA0351-VSGSPSS.care: Unscrew the top, wash both parts in warm soapy water and dry thoroughly, as wet steel can spot and damp shakers make salt clump. Handle the glass base carefully and replace a shaker if it chips.
KKA0351-VSGSPSS.title: VAMA SS Glass Salt & Pepper - Square 120ml
KKA0351-VSGSPSS.meta: Square VAMA stainless steel and glass salt and pepper shakers, 120ml each, with script labels and black three-way pour caps, at Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0352-WSPS4.lead: A short wooden pair for pepper and salt.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Salt & Pepper Set - Walnut Brown in size 4 is a pair of turned wooden pieces about 10cm tall and 5cm wide. One has a steel knob on top and grinds from the base; the other has a pierced steel cap for shaking.
The low 4-inch height keeps the set out of the way on small café tables and tasting counters. As the photos show, the upper section lifts off so the pieces can be refilled without tools.
b: Size 4: About 10cm tall and 5cm wide; the size number matches the height in inches.
Material: Turned wood body with steel fittings at the knob and the pierced cap.
Mill and shaker: Twist the knob-top piece to crack pepper onto the plate; shake salt from the other.
Shape: A flared head over a straight, slightly widening body that stands firmly.
KKA0352-WSPS4.suit: Café tables, tasting-menu service, small dining rooms and hotel breakfast tables.
KKA0352-WSPS4.care: Wipe the wood with a dry or lightly damp cloth, and never soak it or run it through a dishwasher. Fill the mill only with dry whole peppercorns, and keep the set away from steam and the sink.
KKA0352-WSPS4.title: Wooden Salt & Pepper Set - 4 inch (10cm)
KKA0352-WSPS4.meta: Kitchenary Kart wooden salt and pepper set, 4 inch (10cm) tall: a twist-top pepper mill and a pierced-top salt shaker for café and dining tables.
conflicts: Colour: the listing name says Walnut Brown, but the photos show a light honey/natural wood tone. Colour is not described in the copy; the listing name quoted in p1 still contains 'Walnut Brown' and the title leaves it out.

KKA0353-WSPS5.lead: A curved, mid-height mill and shaker pair.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Salt & Pepper Set - Walnut Brown in size 5 stands about 12.5cm tall and 5cm wide, with a rounded head, a narrow waist and ringed feet. One piece has a steel knob and grinds pepper from the bottom; the other carries a pierced steel cap for salt.
At this height it is easy to grip for a few turns over a steak or salad, and the photos show it working over a chopping board and a plate. The pieces open at the top for refilling.
b: Size 5: Around 12.5cm high and 5cm across; the box in the photos reads 5 inch.
Material: Turned wood body with steel fittings at the knob and the pierced cap.
Shape: Curved body with stacked rings at the foot for a classic look.
Tableside grinding: Turn the knob-top mill to crack pepper straight onto the food.
KKA0353-WSPS5.suit: Steakhouses, grill restaurants, bistro tables and hotel à la carte service.
KKA0353-WSPS5.care: Wipe the wood with a dry or lightly damp cloth, and never soak it or run it through a dishwasher. Fill the mill only with dry whole peppercorns, and keep the set away from steam and the sink.
KKA0353-WSPS5.title: Wooden Salt & Pepper Set - 5 inch (12.5cm)
KKA0353-WSPS5.meta: Wooden salt and pepper set, 5 inch (12.5cm), from Kitchenary Kart: a curved pepper mill with steel knob and a pierced-cap salt shaker for bistro tables.
conflicts: Colour: the listing name says Walnut Brown, but the photos show a reddish-brown (terracotta) painted finish. Colour is not described in the copy; the listing name quoted in p1 still contains 'Walnut Brown' and the title leaves it out.

KKA0354-WSPS6.lead: The tallest size: a 15cm mill and shaker.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Salt & Pepper Set - Walnut Brown in size 6 is a tall, slim pair about 15cm high and 5cm wide, with visible wood grain and a gently tapered body. The knob-topped piece is a pepper mill with its grinding mechanism in the base; the other has a holed steel cap for sprinkling salt.

The extra height gives a longer grip for twisting and more room for peppercorns, which suits tableside service at larger dining tables. Photos show it over a bowl of pasta, on a chopping board beside a skillet and grinding onto a plate.
b: Size 6: About 15cm tall and 5cm wide, the tallest option in this listing.
Material: Turned wood body with steel fittings at the knob and the pierced cap.
Wood grain: The natural grain runs along the tapered body.
Base mechanism: Pepper falls straight from the bottom of the mill onto the plate below.
KKA0354-WSPS6.suit: Fine-dining and family restaurants, hotel dining rooms, pasta and steak service, and chef's tables.
KKA0354-WSPS6.care: Wipe the wood with a dry or lightly damp cloth, and never soak it or run it through a dishwasher. Fill the mill only with dry whole peppercorns, and keep the set away from steam and the sink.
KKA0354-WSPS6.title: Wooden Salt & Pepper Set - 6 inch (15cm)
KKA0354-WSPS6.meta: Tall 6 inch (15cm) wooden salt and pepper set from Kitchenary Kart, with a knob-top pepper mill and holed-cap salt shaker for tableside service.
conflicts: Colour: the listing name says Walnut Brown, but the photos show an orange/honey natural wood tone. Colour is not described in the copy; the listing name quoted in p1 still contains 'Walnut Brown' and the title leaves it out.

KKA0452-TH3S.lead: Three tacos stand upright and the fillings stay put.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Taco Holder with 3 slots is one stainless-steel sheet folded into a W shape, about 26cm long, 10cm wide and 5cm high. Each V-shaped groove holds a hard shell or a folded soft tortilla upright while it is filled and served.
Turn the holder over and it forms two slots instead of three, so the same piece handles a smaller order. Staff can load the shells at the counter and send the holder straight out on a plate or board.
b: 3 slots: Three tacos sit side by side in one row.
Material: Stainless steel sheet with smooth, open grooves that wipe clean after greasy fillings.
Reversible: Flipped upside down, it cradles two tacos.
Size: About 26cm long, 10cm wide and 5cm tall.
KKA0452-TH3S.suit: Mexican and Tex-Mex restaurants, QSR counters, food trucks, cafés and party catering that serve tacos in threes.
KKA0452-TH3S.care: Wash in hot soapy water after service, rinse and dry straight away to keep the steel free of water spots. Use a soft sponge rather than steel wool, and let it cool before handling if it has been in the oven.
KKA0452-TH3S.title: SS Taco Holder Stand - 3 Slots
KKA0452-TH3S.meta: Kitchenary Kart stainless steel taco holder with 3 slots, 26cm long, keeps shells upright for filling and serving; flip it over to hold 2.

KKA0453-TH4S.lead: A four-slot rack for full taco platters.
p: The Kitchenary Kart SS Taco Holder with 4 slots is a stainless-steel stand folded into four V-shaped grooves, measuring about 34cm long, 10cm wide and 5cm high. It keeps hard or soft shells standing up so fillings do not spill while they are loaded.
Its length suits a four-taco plate on a serving board or long platter. The photos also show it on an oven tray with filled shells, and holding hot dogs, sandwiches and sushi rolls.
b: 4 slots: Four tacos line up in one straight row.
Material: Stainless steel sheet with smooth, open grooves that wipe clean after greasy fillings.
Oven tray use: Filled shells can warm through in the holder, as pictured.
Size: About 34cm long, 10cm wide and 5cm tall.
